search_window.basis: Latest previously verified Food Line watch-ledger heartbeat completed 06:44:12.786 PST. Search date, crawler date, or scheduled change date alone does not prove a new incident or notice within this interval.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall for Food Line high-value misses; the primary nationwide production collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Only/sole/last/full-service community grocery loss, closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

coverage_notes.observation: Twelve targeted searches returned usable results; no verifiable newly occurring or newly announced qualifying food-access disruption during the observation window was established. Local stories centered on old closures/fires and food bank responses; purported November SNAP shutdown disruptions dated to 2025 rather than 2026. Routine November 2026 pantry scheduling and previously announced eligibility changes were excluded.
